findings.message: Eight evidence-based reference-generation Markdown briefs are present and indexed.
The package prepares reusable references only and does not replace the selected panel-first workflow with complete-page generation.
Generated architecture, layout, object design, and effect appearance remain proposals until separately reviewed and approved.
CANON_APPROVED, STORY_LOCKED, and STORYBOARD_LOCKED are false, image generation is disabled, and named visual dependencies do not yet exist as approved hash-locked files.
This update creates no artwork, schema-valid image job, or paste-ready external handoff.
